title: DuckDB and Apache DataFusion Analytical Engine Documentation

sources.notes: DuckDB docs overview for clients, SQL, import/export, lakehouse formats, extensions, guides, and operations surfaces.
DuckDB data overview for direct file querying/loading across CSV, Parquet, JSON, inserts, COPY, and CREATE TABLE AS SELECT.
DuckDB SQL introduction for relational concepts, PostgreSQL-like dialect posture, tables, schemas, SQL commands, and CLI examples.
DuckDB Parquet query guide for read_parquet, direct FROM clause queries, parallel processing, filter pushdown, and column pruning.
DuckDB repository identity for high-performance analytical database, rich SQL dialect, portability, CLI and client APIs, and direct CSV/Parquet querying.

DataFusion introduction for Rust query engine, Apache Arrow memory format, SQL/DataFrame APIs, file formats, vectorized/multithreaded/streaming execution, optimizer, object stores, extension points, Apache 2.0 license, and Substrait support.
DataFusion DataFrame API docs for lazy logical plans, SessionContext, read_csv, filter/select/aggregate/limit transformations, collect execution, and Expr references.
DataFusion architecture docs for extension APIs, TableProvider, OptimizerRule, ExecutionPlan, public API stability, and downstream customization without forks.
DataFusion SQL reference index and Apache trademark boundary surface; deeper SQL reference pages can be mapped if a Slice prototype needs exact syntax support.
